exposure: excessive mobile phone use during pregnancy
cohort: The cohort consisted of 182 pregnant women admitted during their pregnancy at Hamdard University Hospital, Karachi.
finding: Excessive mobile phone use during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of oligohydramnios, lower birth weight, and a high rate of emergency C-sections.
mod_finding: The study reported high rates of elective (48.4%) and emergency (41.8%) cesarean sections, with only 9.9% of women having a normal vaginal delivery, and linked excessive mobile phone use to a high rate of emergency C-sections.
